title: lesquerella occidentalis subsp. diversifolia
intro: Lesquerella occidentalis subsp. diversifolia, commonly known as the Western Lesquerella, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is known for its edible seeds, which are rich in gamma linolenic acid (GLA), a polyunsaturated fatty acid that has been linked to various health benefits. The health benefits of Lesquerella occidentalis subsp. diversifolia include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate conditions such as eczema and arthritis. The bioactive constituents of the plant include GLA, as well as other fatty acids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
